t: A certified open hardware Linux board built for home servers and storage.
steps: Buy the LIME2 from the Olimex shop for about 43 euros.
Get a 5 V power supply, a microSD card, and a network cable.
Download the Olimage Linux image from the Olimex wiki.
Write the image to the card with a free tool such as balenaEtcher.
Boot the board and log in over the network with SSH.
Try the FreedomBox image from the Debian wiki as a first project.
Check your board revision on the Debian wiki for known Ethernet issues.
meta: Wild Open. From $55.33. A few stores.
